title: Workflows as complex as your science.
takeaway: An investigation can compose flows, concurrent specialists and evidence-dependent follow-up.
proof: Two preparation flows feed three concurrent specialists. Their joined results trigger a fourth specialist when peak times differ by more than one minute. The same graph persists through the finding.
limits: Real deterministic SDK execution, not LLM-generated planning. The one-minute review threshold is an authored example policy. Bootstrap is illustrative; correlation and overlapping extremes do not establish causation. Native flow projections expose task calls/results, while the inspector's step labels condense the retained procedure source.
hardest: Reframe the entire connected graph to inspect one nested flow; return without replacing nodes, then animate the join, decision and conditional branch continuously.

copy.text: A timing mismatch starts a deeper comparison.
